payload.name: Verify Existing Memory Before Skip Already Included
payload.description: Use during construction CRUD decisions when a candidate is marked SKIP with the reason 'already included in the updated memory' or similar. Before skipping, confirm that a prior memory version or the current pool actually contains the fact; otherwise ADD the candidate.
content: Before deciding SKIP on an ADD candidate with reason 'already included in updated memory', check the retrieved existing-memory pool and prior versions for the same subject and fact. If no memory contains that information, do not skip; perform ADD to persist the extracted fact. Only SKIP when you can point to an existing memory version that genuinely includes the fact.

solves: Construction agents sometimes skip a newly extracted fact as 'already included' even when no prior memory contains it, losing durable facts. The reusable rule is to verify the fact exists in the retrieved pool or prior versions before SKIPing for duplication; if not, ADD the candidate. Applies to any future construction CRUD decision where a SKIP reason claims existing coverage but no memory supports it.
